system.itemDescription: You can activate this ability as an action if you are wielding a shield. You hurl your shield at a creature within 10 meters, and it then bounces to a creature of your choice within 10 meters of the first target, and again to a third creature within 10 meters of the second target. It then returns to your hand. Make separate attacks with your shield against all three targets with a bane. Finish the first attack, including damage, before rolling the second one, and finish the second one, including damage, before rolling the third one. Creatures that are hit have a bane when attacking any creature other than you until your turn in the next round.
